repos.name: google-research/timesfm
repos.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
repos.one_liner: A pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for high-accuracy forecasting.
bullets: Built on a decoder-only Transformer architecture optimized for time-series data.
Designed for zero-shot forecasting across diverse domains without task-specific fine-tuning.
Ideal for financial market trend analysis, demand forecasting, and anomaly detection.
Provides a scalable foundation for building custom quant and predictive analytics pipelines.

repos.name: arcboxlabs/arcbox
repos.description: Run AI agents on real and isolated machines — own kernel, filesystem, and network — with <200ms boot. Local first, OCI compatible, pure Rust.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, Rust-based sandbox for running AI agents in isolated, OCI-compatible environments.
bullets: Features a custom kernel and filesystem with sub-200ms boot times for rapid agent execution.
Provides complete network and filesystem isolation to ensure secure agentic operations.
Enables developers to run untrusted AI code in a local-first, production-grade infrastructure.
Supports OCI-compatible images, making it easy to integrate into existing DevOps workflows.

repos.name: getagentseal/codeburn
repos.description: Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 37 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more), by model, project, and task. npx codeburn
repos.one_liner: A local CLI tool to track AI coding token usage and costs across 37+ different agents and IDEs.
bullets: Supports granular cost tracking for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other major LLM tools.
Aggregates data by project, model, and task to provide actionable financial insights.
Operates locally to ensure privacy while maintaining visibility into AI development spend.
Essential for engineering managers and teams optimizing their AI-assisted development budget.

repos.name: pacifio/atlas
repos.one_liner: A specialized source control system designed specifically for the needs of AI agents.
bullets: Implements versioning logic tailored for agentic workflows rather than traditional human commits.
Focuses on state management and context tracking to improve agent reliability over long tasks.
Provides a structured interface for agents to read, write, and revert changes in a codebase.
Acts as a critical infrastructure layer for autonomous software engineering agents.

repos.name: LiquidGiraffe8/Metatrader-5-Plus-Edge
repos.description: Automated MetaTrader 5 (MT5) algorithmic execution framework. Features open-source Python API integration, real-time technical analysis, and risk management tools.
repos.one_liner: An automated algorithmic execution framework for MetaTrader 5 with Python integration.
bullets: Provides a robust Python API wrapper for MT5 to facilitate advanced algorithmic trading strategies.
Includes built-in modules for real-time technical analysis and automated risk management.
Streamlines the deployment of quantitative models into live financial market environments.
Designed for high-frequency execution and systematic trading automation.
